node.statement: For each T in {U,V}, the defining equality T^dagger bold-dot T=J and the C*-lower axiom give 1=||T^dagger bold-dot T||>=(1-epsilon_r)||T||^2, hence ||T||=||T^dagger||<=2. For every Y, exact unitality, T^dagger bold-dot T=J, the associator bound, and the product-norm bound give ||Y||<=epsilon_r||T||^2||Y||+(1+epsilon_r)||T||*||T bold-dot Y||. Since epsilon_r<=1/64 and ||T||<=2, this implies ||T bold-dot Y||>=(1-4epsilon_r)/(2(1+epsilon_r))*||Y||>=6/13*||Y||>=(1/3)||Y||. Thus L_T is injective; finite dimensionality makes L_T bijective, with ||L_T^{-1}||<=3. Consequently A=L_U composed with L_V is invertible, A^{-1}=L_V^{-1} composed with L_U^{-1}, and ||A^{-1}||<=9. This derives the multiplier estimate directly from the allowed definitions and does not invoke node 1.2.
